text: "We spend so much time backing up thousands of family photos to the cloud, but we often ignore a major blind spot: accessibility. If you aren't adding metadata or descriptions, those digital memories remain invisible to friends or family members who rely on screen readers. A true backup isn't just about storage space; it's about usability. We need to start prioritizing alt text during the curation process so that our digital legacies are actually accessible to everyone."
